note: Consensus line is the one the most books post; over/under are the median price at that line; best_over is the best available price for taking the over. `implied` is the break-even percentage — compare it to a hit rate, not to a score. `movement` retains up to eight changed intraday observations; positive probability-point movement means the price shortened, negative means it drifted. A line change is a different bet and has no price delta.
